title: Is seventy five divisible by twenty one?
description: The primes of twenty one are looked for one by one in the row of primes of seventy five. Keeko doubts this and says sharing the prime three is enough.
teaching_notes: One idea: if even one prime of the divisor is missing from the number, the number is not divisible. Watch for students who stop after finding one shared prime.

source: Is 75 divisible by 21? Find the prime factorisations of both
video_script.why: The child sees that a number is not divisible by another when one prime of the divisor is missing from the number.
video_script.substitution: the book's own numbers, seventy five and twenty one
video_script.anchor: the rows of primes of seventy five and twenty one, with the primes of twenty one ticked or crossed in the row of seventy five
video_script.wrong_answer: sharing the prime three is enough
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko sees the prime three in both rows and stops looking at the other prime of twenty one.
video_script.payoff_line: Seventy five is not divisible by twenty one

final_answer.spoken: seventy five is not divisible by twenty one

maths_rules: the prime 3 of 21 is in the row of 75
the prime 7 of 21 is not in the row of 75
if 75 were a multiple of 21, all the primes of 21 would be in 75, so 75 is not divisible by 21
video_script.design: The rows of primes of seventy five and twenty one are lined up. Each prime of twenty one is looked for in the row of seventy five and ticked or crossed.

beats.on_screen: a small title card From your book; the rows 75 = 3 × 5 × 5 and 21 = 3 × 7 stand on the board with a question mark between them

narration: <bookmark mark='book'/>This is a question from your book about seventy five and twenty one.
<bookmark mark='rows'/>Seventy five is three times five times five. Twenty one is three times seven.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>Is seventy five divisible by twenty one?

beats.on_screen: the two rows stay on the board; Keeko sits at the corner of the board as the child

marks.think: Keeko sits at the corner of the board

beats.on_screen: a longer row of primes with a shorter row ringed inside it; a tick or a cross waits beside each prime of the shorter row

marks.rule: a shorter row of primes is ringed inside a longer row
marks.one: a tick or a cross appears beside each prime of the shorter row, one by one

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>A number is divisible by another when the primes of the other are all included in its primes.
<bookmark mark='one'/>We check the primes of the divisor one by one.

marks.given: the two rows are written under the word Given

beats.colours: 3s in amber, 5s in gold, 7 in rose
narration: <bookmark mark='given'/>Given, the rows of primes of seventy five and of twenty one.

beats.on_screen: To find: whether every prime of 21 is in the row of 75
narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find whether every prime of twenty one is in the row of seventy five.

beats.on_screen: Step 1: the first prime of 21 is 3, and the row of 75 has a 3

marks.three: the 3 of the row of 21 is matched with the 3 of the row of 75 and ticked

narration: <bookmark mark='three'/>Step one, look for the first prime of twenty one. It is three, and the row of seventy five has a three.

beats.on_screen: Step 2: the next prime of 21 is 7, and the row of 75 has no 7

marks.seven: the 7 of the row of 21 is looked for in the row of 75 and is crossed out

narration: <bookmark mark='seven'/>Step two, look for the next prime of twenty one. It is seven, and the row of seventy five has no seven.

beats.on_screen: Step 3: check: if the row of 21 sat inside the row of 75, both its primes would be there; one prime is missing

marks.miss: the row of 21 is placed over the row of 75 and the 7 hangs outside it

narration: <bookmark mark='miss'/>Step three, check the rule. If the row of twenty one sat inside, both its primes would be there, but one is missing.

beats.on_screen: Answer: No, 75 is not divisible by 21

marks.ans: the answer is boxed in green

narration: <bookmark mark='ans'/>No. Seventy five is not divisible by twenty one, because the prime seven is missing from its row.

beats.on_screen: Keeko with a raised hand beside the board
narration: <bookmark mark='hand'/>Keeko has raised a hand. Let us check the doubt and solve it.

beats.on_screen: Keeko's bubble says sharing the prime three is enough; the 3 is ticked and the 7 of 21 is left hanging outside the row of 75; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

marks.gap: the 3 is ticked and the 7 of 21 hangs outside the row of 75

narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks sharing the prime three is enough.
<bookmark mark='gap'/>But twenty one also needs a seven, and seventy five has no seven at all.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>One shared prime is not enough, because every prime of the divisor must be inside.
